title: Fix catastrophic cancellation in a variance kernel (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C: a 32-element single-block variance reduction. The shipped kernel uses the single-pass E[x^2]-E[x]^2 formula, which returns a NEGATIVE variance (-16384) on a large-mean fixture where the true variance is 4.8896484375; a mean-centered two-pass reduction gets it exactly right.
